title: Uniqueness of a normalized rational tensor comparison
statement: For the same data, any two RationalComparison packages satisfying the target theorem’s normalization, Frobenius equation, and ordinary/completed Weil-pair isomorphism conjuncts are equal.

proof.text: Normalization identifies the two ordinary bifunctors after precomposition with the product of the integral localizations, and likewise the completed bifunctors. Apply scalarLocalization_precomp_injective from WeilTensorProduct in each variable, using currying and flipping, to obtain equality of both rational bifunctors. After substituting these equalities, compare each of chi, ordinaryMu and completedMu componentwise. Every rational object is an unchanged integral object, so the prescribed HEq components in the two normalizations have the same right hand sides and give equality. Isomorphism and natural-transformation extensionality identify the three isomorphisms; structure extensionality identifies the packages. Only the normalization conjuncts of FullProperty are needed.

lean.statement:
theorem wfTensorCompletionFrobenius_unique (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (c : D.CoefficientDatum)
    (X₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀))) [IsSeparated X₀.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X₀.hom] [QuasiCompact X₀.hom]
    (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields c.l c.Qbar)
    (R S : WfTensorCompletion.RationalComparison D c X₀ E)
    (hR : WfTensorCompletion.FullProperty D c X₀ E R)
    (hS : WfTensorCompletion.FullProperty D c X₀ E S) : R = S
